To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a system for fast grasp planning and delivery planning for unknown objects using one single image.

1) we have presented a fast vision-based grasping and delivery planning for unknown objects, 2) we have presented an approach to solve the delivery planning with respect to the object packing problem, 3) we have presented the results of our test runs with several unknown objects, 4) the system is robust against occlusion and illumination changes, 5) the system is able to deliver objects in different positions and orientations.
we have developed a system that is able to grasp and deliver unknown objects with a single camera image.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How can a robot plan a grasp and a delivery of an unknown object with one single image?
the following questions: How can an unknown object be grasped?
the development of a system for the manipulation of unknown objects.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented system can be used to solve the problem of grasps planning and delivery planning for unknown objects.
the presented approach is a promising basis for further research on fast vision-based manipulation planning.
the proposed system is a first step towards the realization of a robot, which is able to tidy up a room autonomously.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to grasp and deliver unknown objects by a single camera image.
the system is able to grasp and deliver unknown objects in a fast and reliable manner.
we have developed a robust system for grasping and delivery of unknown objects with a single camera image.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the system is able to plan a delivery for all the tested objects, which are unknown for the system, and to execute the delivery with an industrial robot.
a single camera image is enough for grasping and delivering an unknown object, which can be used in a variety of applications.
a fast grasp and delivery planning is possible with a single camera image, which is sufficient to build up a fast and robust system.
